Free public safety center

Verify before freight changes hands.

A profile badge, subscription, email, or text is never enough by itself. Match official records, identity, equipment, insurance, and pickup details before releasing freight.

Pickup checklist

Before the truck arrives

  1. Confirm commodity, dimensions, weight, value, and handling requirements.
  2. Set a specific pickup window and named contact.
  3. Confirm dock, forklift, liftgate, ramp, pallet jack, and driver-assist needs.
  4. Match the driver, truck, plate, carrier name, USDOT/MC, and insurance.
  5. Photograph count and condition before loading.
  6. Keep the rate confirmation, messages, bill of lading, pickup proof, and delivery proof.

Stop and recheck when

  • The company name, phone, email domain, or payment instructions suddenly change.
  • The driver or truck does not match the information provided.
  • A party pressures you to move off-platform or skip normal documents.
  • The rate, equipment promise, or pickup story changes after acceptance.
  • The load is duplicated, old, vague, or cannot be reconfirmed.
Emergency or suspected crime? Contact local law enforcement and the appropriate government agency. Relocation Manager USA does not replace legal, insurance, or regulatory advice.
